From Ratt · Price: automatic only; the darts fire at anything moving.

Theme Affliction · Stand type automatic only

  • 1: 1 action: dart, range 30 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[acid]] (attack roll).
  • 5: @Damage[1d6[persistent,acid]] on a hit.
  • 9: Surge: three darts at different targets, each @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[acid]].
  • 13: Darts melt a creature's flesh: on a critical hit, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} for 1 minute.
  • 17: Darts ignore resistance to acid.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
